memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine COPD follow-up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports stable dyspnoea on exertion, uses salbutamol inhaler SOS about 2-3 times per week, no recent exacerbations.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/82 mmHg, weight 62 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 22.0 (normal). Respiratory rate 18, SpO2 94% on room air, breath sounds bilateral vesicular with occasional wheeze at bases.
IMPRESSION: COPD, stable. No weight loss, continue current inhalers. Advise diet and activity as BMI <23, no specific advice needed.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue tiotropium inhaler OD, salbutamol inhaler SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD. Offer influenza vaccine (patient declined, to reconsider in autumn). Return if: increased dyspnoea at rest, new chest pain, fever >38.5°C, bloody sputum.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg, 1 inhalation OD
Salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg, 2 puffs SOS
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg, 2 inhalations BD

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 1.12 L (45% predicted), FVC 2.30 L, FEV1/FVC ratio 0.49 (49%). Consistent with moderate COPD.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Chest X-ray (PA): Hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no acute infiltrate or pleural effusion. No new changes compared to prior.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting blood sugar: 98 mg/dL (70-99 normal).
Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 168 mg/dL (<200 desirable), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40 male normal), LDL 95 mg/dL (<100 optimal), Triglycerides 138 mg/dL (<150 normal).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine COPD review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes occasional increase in breathlessness on walking uphill, uses salbutamol 4-5 times/week, no fever or sputum change.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/84 mmHg, weight 63 kg, BMI 22.3 (normal). SpO2 93% room air, respiratory rate 20, mild wheeze bilaterally.
IMPRESSION: COPD, mild worsening of symptoms, likely due to seasonal variation. Continue current regimen, consider checking inhaler technique.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD. Review inhaler technique with nurse. Offer influenza vaccine (patient accepts, to be given in September). Return if: dyspnoea at rest, chest pain, fever >38.5°C, increased sputum purulence.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: follow-up after reported increased dyspnoea.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports increased breathlessness on level ground over past 2 weeks, using salbutamol 6-8 times/day, occasional wheeze, no fever, sputum clear.
EXAMINATION: BP 142/86 mmHg, weight 63.5 kg, BMI 22.5 (normal). SpO2 90% on room air, respiratory rate 22, use of accessory muscles, diffuse wheeze.
IMPRESSION: COPD exacerbation, mild-moderate. Initiate short course oral steroids and ensure bronchodilator availability.
ARRANGEMENTS: Prednisolone 40 mg OD for 5 days, then stop. Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD. Ensure spacer use. Offer influenza vaccine (administered today 0.5 mL IM). Return if: dyspnoea worsens at rest, chest pain, fever >38.5°C, bloody sputum, swelling of legs.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: post-exacerbation review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels back to baseline, dyspnoea on exertion similar to pre-exacerbation, salbutamol use 2-3 times/week, no fever.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/80 mmHg, weight 62 kg, BMI 22.0 (normal). SpO2 94% room air, respiratory rate 18, mild wheeze at lung bases.
IMPRESSION: COPD, stable after exacerbation. Continue maintenance inhalers, monitor for further exacerbations.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD. Offer influenza vaccine (already given autumn 2025, next due autumn 2026). Return if: increased dyspnoea at rest, chest pain, fever >38.5°C, change in sputum colour.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine COPD review, influenza vaccine update.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports stable dyspnoea on exertion, salbutamol use 2-3 times/week, no exacerbations since spring.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/82 mmHg, weight 61.5 kg, BMI 21.8 (normal). SpO2 95% room air, respiratory rate 18, clear lungs with occasional wheeze at bases.
IMPRESSION: COPD, stable. BMI normal, advise maintain activity and balanced diet.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD. Influenza vaccine administered today (0.5 mL IM). Return if: dyspnoea at rest, chest pain, fever >38.5°C, bloody sputum.
